places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Lorena bathes; Deets pulls the thorn from feverish Jake's thumb, warns of a storm, and swims Lorena's balky mare across to the far bank.
places.location_hint: reached on Jake and Lorena's second day out, through mesquite and prickly pear, ahead of the herd; they end camped on the north bank

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Frightened, Lorena half wishes she had stayed at the Dry Bean or married Xavier.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Lorena knows reaching it means many more river crossings and briefly calls the dream foolish.

groups.label: Jake and Lorena
groups.hint: camped under a big mesquite on the north bank, bracing for a storm from the south

groups.label: Deets
groups.hint: recrossing south to guide the herd to the crossing

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: herd some distance back, south of the Nueces, its dust visible behind Jake and Lorena
